title: Told Keeper Wren 'you've not reached Rowan yet' even though I had already met and fully talked with Keeper Rowan at the Understory in Thornwold much earlier in the playthrough — the game didn't recognize that cross-reference and gave a generic 'she'll keep' response instead of resolving the linked quest.
where: Hollowbrook / The Keepers' Hall, talking to Keeper Wren
